new = '''def _split(node, low, high):
    """Pieces of ``node[low:high]`` in byte order for inner ('C'/'R') nodes.

    Each piece is ``('s', subsequence)`` when it covers the child completely,
    otherwise ``('r', subsequence, low, high)``.
    """
    tag = node.tag
    if tag == 'C':
        left = node.a
        ln = left.n
        if high <= ln:
            yield ('s', left) if low == 0 else ('r', left, low, high)
        elif low >= ln:
            right = node.b
            yield ('s', right) if high - ln == right.n else ('r', right, 0, high - ln)
        else:
            yield ('s', left) if low == 0 else ('r', left, low, ln)
            right = node.b
            yield ('s', right) if high - ln == right.n else ('r', right, 0, high - ln)
    else:
        base = node.a
        bl = base.n
        first = low // bl
        offset = low % bl
        last = (high - 1) // bl
        lastoff = (high - 1) % bl
        if first == last:
            yield ('s', base) if offset == 0 and lastoff + 1 == bl else ('r', base, offset, lastoff + 1)
        else:
            if offset:
                yield ('r', base, offset, bl)
            middle = last - first - 1
            if middle > 0:
                yield ('s', repeat(base, middle))
            yield ('r', base, 0, lastoff + 1) if lastoff + 1 < bl else ('s', base)


def _pieces(stack):
    """Pop-driven expansion of the work stack into ordered segments."""
    raise NotImplementedError


def slice_seq(seq, lo, hi):
    """Byte slice ``seq[lo:hi]`` as a compressed sequence."""
    if lo >= hi:
        return EMPTY
    if lo == 0 and hi == seq.n:
        return seq
    parts = []
    stack = [('r', seq, lo, hi)]
    while stack:
        item = stack.pop()
        if item[0] == 's':
            parts.append(item[1])
            continue
        node, low, high = item[1], item[2], item[3]
        if low >= high:
            continue
        if low == 0 and high == node.n:
            parts.append(node)
            continue
        if node.tag == 'L':
            parts.append(leaf(node.a[low:high]))
            continue
        stack.extend(reversed(list(_split(node, low, high))))
    return concat_all(parts)


def range_hash(seq, lo, hi):
    """Fingerprint (length, value) of ``seq[lo:hi]`` without materializing."""
    if lo >= hi:
        return 0, 0
    if lo == 0 and hi == seq.n:
        return seq.n, seq.h
    total_n = 0
    total_h = 0
    stack = [('r', seq, lo, hi)]
    while stack:
        item = stack.pop()
        if item[0] == 's':
            node = item[1]
            total_h = (total_h * pow(BASE, node.n, MOD) + node.h) % MOD
            total_n += node.n
            continue
        node, low, high = item[1], item[2], item[3]
        if low >= high:
            continue
        if low == 0 and high == node.n:
            total_h = (total_h * pow(BASE, node.n, MOD) + node.h) % MOD
            total_n += node.n
            continue
        if node.tag == 'L':
            data = node.a[low:high]
            total_h = (total_h * pow(BASE, len(data), MOD) + hash_bytes(data)) % MOD
            total_n += len(data)
            continue
        stack.extend(reversed(list(_split(node, low, high))))
    return total_n, total_h


def materialize(seq, lo, hi):
    """Return the literal bytes of ``seq[lo:hi]`` (bounded windows only)."""
    if lo >= hi:
        return b''
    if hi - lo > MATERIALIZE_LIMIT:
        raise ValueError('bounded materialization')
    parts = []
    stack = [('r', seq, lo, hi)]
    while stack:
        item = stack.pop()
        if item[0] == 's':
            node = item[1]
            if node.tag == 'L':
                parts.append(node.a)
            elif node.tag == 'R':
                parts.append(node.a * node.b)
            else:
                stack.append(('s', node.b))
                stack.append(('s', node.a))
            continue
        node, low, high = item[1], item[2], item[3]
        if low >= high:
            continue
        if low == 0 and high == node.n:
            stack.append(('s', node))
            continue
        if node.tag == 'L':
            parts.append(node.a[low:high])
            continue
        stack.extend(reversed(list(_split(node, low, high))))
    return b''.join(parts)
